test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 5: COURSE STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT (DELETION & ORGANIZATION) - Phase 2: Manage and Delete Files
test_cases.test_case_title: Access Sessions Tab for Session Management
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'NewSecurePass123!' is logged into the system. The teacher has navigated to the 'Course Details Page' for a pre-existing course that contains at least one session and one file.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Sessions' tab is successfully accessed. The system displays the session management interface, including the list of existing sessions and options for adding, editing, or deleting sessions. The course information, schedule, and uploaded materials are visible.
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher is on the 'Sessions' tab of the 'Course Details Page', ready to manage sessions for the course.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Sessions' tab to open the session management interface.
